info.title: Dynamic Mockups Universal API
info.description: Dynamic Mockups generates product mockups and print assets from templates and PSD files via API.

post.description: Creates bulk renders from a Dynamic Mockups collection.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

collection_uuid.description: UUID of the Dynamic Mockups collection to bulk render.

artworks.description: JSON object mapping artwork input keys to image URLs or files.

colors.description: JSON object mapping color input keys to hex color values.

export_label.description: Optional label returned back in bulk render response.

export_options.image_format.description: Optional export format: jpg, png, or webp.
